text: Tenderer must hold valid liability insurance for its operations with cover of at least EUR 1,000,000.
Tenderer must hold electrical contracting rights (sahkourakointioikeudet) of at least class S2.
Tenderer must have at least three (3) equivalent reference projects from the last five years.
Tenderer's revenue must be at least EUR 5,000,000 in the most recent financial year.
Condition-monitoring data collection (kunnonvalvonnan tiedonkeruu) must be addressed.
Continuity of service through staff changes (palvelun jatkuvuus henkilostomuutoksissa) must be addressed.
Waste management and waste sorting on site (jatehuolto ja jatteen lajittelu tyomaalla) must be addressed.
Handover of the asset register and documentation must be addressed.
Warranty period for installed equipment (asennettujen laitteiden takuuaika) must be addressed.
Periodic statutory inspections of electrical installations (sahkoasennusten maaraaikaistarkastukset) must be addressed.
Worker qualification requirements on site must be addressed.
Spare parts availability and delivery time must be addressed.
Content and scheduling of maintenance visits (huoltokaynnin sisalto ja ajoitus) must be addressed.
Response time for fault situations must be at most 4 hours from notification (hataytilanteiden vasteaika on enintaan 4 tuntia ilmoituksesta).
Contract period and extension options must be addressed.
Invoicing frequency and format (laskutustiheys ja -muoto) must be addressed.
A cost breakdown requirement must be addressed.
Pricing structure (fixed price / unit price / time-based charging) must be addressed.
A trade register extract (kaupparekisteriote) must be enclosed with the quotation.
A certificate of tax payment (todistus verojen maksusta) must be enclosed with the quotation.
File format: quotation must be a single PDF file with no password protection.
Price must be stated as EUR/m2/year, not EUR/month.
The tender document is subject to a page limit of at most 20 pages, excluding attachments.
Reference currency for framework agreement pricing must be stated as required.
Inspection of building envelope condition (rakennuksen vaipan kunnon tarkastus) must be addressed.
Reporting practice to the client (raportointikaytanto tilaajalle) must be addressed.
An occupational safety plan (tyoturvallisuussuunnitelma) must be addressed.
Compliance of elevator servicing with regulations (hissien huollon maaraystenmukaisuus) must be addressed.

This annex clause states that the technical specification sets the fault response time at 2 hours (liitteen teknisessa erittelyssa vasteajaksi on merkitty 2 tuntia) -- contradicting the body's clause 4.10, which states a maximum of 4 hours from notification.
